articles.title: INS Aridhaman: India gets third nuclear submarine with 3,500 km missile range; here's what makes this underwater war machine special
articles.summary: INS Aridhaman, India's newest nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine (SSBN), was commissioned on April 3, 2026. This landmark event significantly bolsters India's sea-based nuclear deterrence, solidifying its nuclear triad and enhancing second-strike capabilities. For SSB aspirants, this represents a crucial advancement in national defence, reinforcing India's strategic autonomy and maritime security, vital for upholding peace and stability in the region.

articles.title: Kamikaze drone: Indian Army gets hundreds of suicide flying machines from Gujarat firm that can survive at -35 degrees
articles.summary: Alpha Trade provides financial services offering daily trade ideas from SEBI-registered analysts, along with investment insights to help grow wealth. The platform includes stock recommendations, analysis of sectoral trends, and comprehensive stock research tools. This initiative highlights the availability of regulated financial guidance within the national market, aiding individuals in their investment decisions and contributing to economic activity.

articles.title: Jindal Stainless names Ranveer Singh as first brand ambassador
articles.summary: Jindal Stainless Ltd (JSL), India's leading stainless steel manufacturer, has announced Bollywood superstar Ranveer Singh as its first-ever brand ambassador. This strategic partnership aims to significantly boost JSL's brand visibility and market reach across the nation, leveraging Singh's immense popularity. It marks a notable collaboration between a major Indian industry player and a prominent celebrity.

articles.title: Iran defiant as deadline looms for Trump threat to infrastructure
articles.summary: A political demonstration occurred in Tehran's Valiasr Square, where Iranian citizens expressed solidarity with the government. A prominent banner featured missiles being fired, symbolizing Iran's defence capabilities and national resolve. This display in April highlights the nation's stance, potentially amidst regional tensions or in reaffirmation of its military strength, underscoring popular support for governmental policies, especially regarding national security.

articles.title: Iran defiant on eve of Trump's ceasefire deadline
articles.summary: Iran and Israel exchanged attacks on Tuesday, escalating regional tensions. Tehran defiantly refused to reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz and rejected a ceasefire deal. This defiance occurred on the eve of a crucial deadline set by U.S. President Donald Trump, underscoring significant international security challenges and the critical geopolitical importance of the Strait.
